blockers.detail: The paper does not identify the native-4K Figure 5 image suite or image count.

The local 120000-step and batch-60000 values are sensitivity assumptions, not published protocol.
Published Table 1 values align with the Appendix L2/GELU/dual-cosine row while the main text describes L1/LeakyReLU/fixed LR.
Local runners freeze optimizer and seed choices that the paper does not fully report.
The authors' C++/HIP 512-cubed converter is unreleased; the Open3D protocol is auditable but not bit-exact.
Canonical Pitted Stonefish requires an authorized academic Sketchfab download; no substitute or numeric Table 4 result is permitted.
